correctness.rationale: For resting clique vertices the excitation signal is precisely the number of excited clique plus fringe vertices; for resting fringe vertices it is the excited clique count. Initial phase classes remain uniform, and truncating each of six initial multiplicities at two preserves every threshold-two test at every step by induction. Exhaustively checking all 729 truncated six-class profiles at times five and eight proves F^8=F^5 for all positive a,b. Once periods divide three, a periodic vertex is either rest forever or rotates 0->1->2->0. The common excitation signal forces every vertex to rotate on any nonzero periodic orbit, and the three phase-support inequalities are necessary and sufficient. Multinomial weighting yields R(a,b); explicit phase-profile enumeration gives the a=4 and a=5 formulas, while inclusion-exclusion and two-colour fringe support give the three growth regimes. The concrete S_(3,3) trajectory takes five steps to reach rest. Independent labelled-state iteration verified 29,169 states across eleven parameter pairs; verify.py and verify_output.txt accompany the result. Finite enumeration is used only after a proved exact reduction, not extrapolated from small graphs.

originality.rationale: The closest directly inspected work is classical Greenberg-Hastings contact-threshold dynamics on lattices and the stable-periodic-object framework, which provides a sufficient rotating-support mechanism but not an exact recurrent-state census for complete split graphs. A deterministic arbitrary-graph treatment uses threshold one, while the later threshold-two tree result studies infinite regular trees and probability. A scale-free-network study uses stochastic excitation and external stimuli. Accessible prior project claims for threshold-two complete bipartite graphs and majority split graphs do not imply the threshold-two Greenberg-Hastings split-graph result because the update rules and clique internal adjacency differ. Indexed-record, publication, parameter-variant and formula searches identified no equivalent uniform five-step law together with the 0/log2/log3 census. value.rationale: This is a complete recurrent-state enumeration on a natural split network, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The degree-heterogeneous clique/fringe architecture admits a genuine three-phase asymptotic law as fringe population grows: no nonzero recurrence for clique at most three, binary-exponential for clique sizes four or five, and ternary-exponential for clique sizes six or more. The two sharp small-core formulas have structural meaning as phase-support thresholds, while a universal sharp five-step stabilization bound makes the all-state classification stronger than a mere periodic-state construction. These facts can serve as explicit test cases for graph-structured excitable-media theory.
